comparison: A fixed extension of 250 new paired runners in the same four initial contexts. Each runner executes a fresh drift history and a fresh unchanged-control history. The source background model is reused byte-for-byte, without refitting or threshold selection. Test order is balanced 125/125. Original test results are reported separately, not pooled into the extension's primary result.
sample_size_note: The extension was requested after the original twenty-pair result was inspected. Its size is fixed at 250 attempted pairs before execution, with no outcome-based stopping or replacement of settling failures. It estimates performance conditional on one frozen background fit/calibration; it does not remove uncertainty in that fit or establish transfer to other systems.
